text:
Type: tall glass-door bookcase
Use: storing and displaying books and collections; living room, home office, study
Style: contemporary, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: painted board in a smooth finish, clear glass doors in painted frames, adjustable shelves
Colors: deep navy blue
Shape: tall narrow cabinet with two framed glass doors split by a crossbar, small round knobs, several shelves, low plinth base, slim and upright
Feel: deep, calm, studious, rich
Goes with: brass or gold accents, white walls, warm wood, leather; classic or contemporary studies and living rooms

product.name: BILLY
product.description: Glass doors keep your favourite items free from dust but still visible.
